# WebGL Fluid Enhanced 0.8.0

`dist/index.es.js` from the npm package `webgl-fluid-enhanced@0.8.0`.
Local patches: preserveDrawingBuffer keeps a paused frame visible; restarting
reuses existing framebuffers when the size has not changed; stop removes touch
listeners using the same capture flag used to register them.
Source: https://github.com/michaelbrusegard/WebGL-Fluid-Enhanced
Based on https://github.com/PavelDoGreat/WebGL-Fluid-Simulation
MIT license is included alongside the module. No runtime CDN requests.
